title: alpha-Bisabolol Mitigates Colon Inflammation by Stimulating Colon PPAR-gamma Transcription Factor: In Vivo and In Vitro Study.
authors: Venkataraman, Balaji; Almarzooqi, Saeeda; Raj, Vishnu; Dudeja, Pradeep K; Bhongade, Bhoomendra A; Patil, Rajesh B; Ojha, Shreesh K; Attoub, Samir; Adrian, Thomas E; Subramanya, Sandeep B
one_liner_zh: 该文研究alpha-Bisabolol通过刺激PPAR-gamma转录因子缓解结肠炎症，虽涉及分子对接与动态模拟，但核心是药物抗炎机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: The incidence and prevalence of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD, Crohn's disease, and ulcerative colitis) are increasing worldwide. The etiology of IBD is multifactorial, including genetic predisposition, dysregulated immune response, microbial dysbiosis, and environmental factors. However, many of the existing therapies are associated with marked side effects. Therefore, the development of new drugs for IBD treatment is an important area of investigation. Here, we investigated the anti-inflammatory effects of alpha-bisabolol, a naturally occurring monocyclic sesquiterpene alcohol present in many aromatic plants, in colonic inflammation. To address this, we used molecular docking and dynamic studies to understand how alpha-bisabolol interacts with PPAR-gamma, which is highly expressed in the colonic epithelium: in vivo (mice) and in vitro (RAW264.7 macrophages and HT-29 colonic adenocarcinoma cells) models. The molecular docking and dynamic analysis revealed that alpha-bisabolol interacts with PPAR-gamma, a nuclear receptor protein that is highly expressed in the colon epithelium. Treatment with alpha-bisabolol in DSS-administered mice significantly reduced Disease Activity Index (DAI), myeloperoxidase (MPO) activity, and colonic length and protected the microarchitecture of the colon. alpha-Bisabolol treatment also reduced the expression of proinflammatory cytokines (IL-6, IL1beta, TNF-alpha, and IL-17A) at the protein and mRNA levels. The expression of COX-2 and iNOS inflammatory mediators were reduced along with tissue nitrite levels. Furthermore, alpha-bisabolol decreased the phosphorylation of activated mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK) signaling and nuclear factor kappa B (NFkappaB) proteins and enhanced colon epithelial PPAR-gamma transcription factor expression. However, the PPAR-alpha and beta/delta expression was not altered, indicating alpha-bisabolol is a specific stimulator of PPAR-gamma. alpha-Bisabolol also increased the PPAR-gamma transcription factor expression but not PPAR-alpha and beta/delta in pretreated in LPS-stimulated RAW264.7 macrophages. alpha-Bisabolol significantly decreased the expression of proinflammatory chemokines (CXCL-1 and IL-8) mRNA in HT-29 cells treated with TNF-alpha and HT-29 PPAR-gamma promoter activity. These results demonstrate that alpha-bisabolol mitigates colonic inflammation by inhibiting MAPK signaling and stimulating PPAR-gamma expression.
abstract_zh: 炎症性肠病（IBD，包括克罗恩病和溃疡性结肠炎）的发病率和患病率在全球范围内呈上升趋势。IBD的病因是多因素的，包括遗传易感性、免疫反应失调、微生物菌群失调和环境因素。然而，许多现有疗法伴有显著的不良反应。因此，开发用于IBD治疗的新药是一个重要的研究领域。在本研究中，我们探讨了α-红没药醇（alpha-bisabolol）——一种存在于多种芳香植物中的天然单环倍半萜醇——在结肠炎症中的抗炎作用。为此，我们采用分子对接和分子动力学研究来理解α-红没药醇如何与PPAR-γ（在结肠上皮中高表达）相互作用，并使用了体内（小鼠）和体外（RAW264.7巨噬细胞和HT-29结肠腺癌细胞）模型。分子对接和动力学分析显示，α-红没药醇与PPAR-γ（一种在结肠上皮中高表达的核受体蛋白）相互作用。在DSS诱导的小鼠中，α-红没药醇处理显著降低了疾病活动指数（DAI）、髓过氧化物酶（MPO）活性和结肠长度，并保护了结肠的微结构。α-红没药醇处理还降低了促炎细胞因子（IL-6、IL1β、TNF-α和IL-17A）在蛋白质和mRNA水平的表达。COX-2和iNOS炎症介质的表达以及组织亚硝酸盐水平均有所降低。此外，α-红没药醇降低了活化丝裂原活化蛋白激酶（MAPK）信号和核因子κB（NFκB）蛋白的磷酸化，并增强了结肠上皮PPAR-γ转录因子的表达。然而，PPAR-α和β/δ的表达未发生改变，表明α-红没药醇是PPAR-γ的特异性刺激剂。在LPS刺激的RAW264.7巨噬细胞中，α-红没药醇也增加了PPAR-γ转录因子的表达，但未影响PPAR-α和β/δ。在TNF-α处理的HT-29细胞中，α-红没药醇显著降低了促炎趋化因子（CXCL-1和IL-8）mRNA的表达以及HT-29 PPAR-γ启动子活性。这些结果表明，α-红没药醇通过抑制MAPK信号和刺激PPAR-γ表达来缓解结肠炎症。
